controls.authentication: not-applicable: CI-only read-only tooling; runner identity is repository read access and never a production user session.
controls.authorization: not-applicable: CI tooling has no business object authority or production credentials; repository reviewers authorize policy changes.
controls.currentPermissions: not-applicable: No persisted business grants are consumed; workflow permissions are independently constrained and tested.
controls.origin: not-applicable: No HTTP entry or browser cookies are accepted; the input is a local checkout on an isolated runner.
controls.rateLimit: not-applicable: No public request endpoint exists; the workflow uses an explicit ten-minute execution timeout and bounded subprocess output.
controls.schema: not-applicable: This read-only CI tool has no HTTP payload Schema; its policy and scanner report checks are covered by dedicated unit tests.
controls.bodyLimit: not-applicable: No HTTP body is consumed; git source reads use a 32 MiB subprocess output limit and only repository-tracked source paths.
controls.responseLimit: not-applicable: No business response or export is emitted; the gate prints finding identifiers and status without source snippets.
controls.cache: not-applicable: The scanner has no shared data cache; PR checkout does not persist repository credentials or production data.
controls.sensitiveData: not-applicable: The tool emits finding identifiers and statuses, not business records or credential values; no PII transformation occurs.
controls.audit: not-applicable: This scanner does not mutate auditable business state; it reports its outcomes through ordinary CI logs.
controls.stateMachine: not-applicable: Read-only checks do not mutate business state, user grants, migrations or production services.
